htmlBody:
Enclosed stacks still need a gateway to the open plane. Today’s tip is the IBM SNA ↔ TCP/IP case study: Interlink-class bridges as a fractal rhyme for Omni-Lattice Chat — Caracas / PDVSA / Protocol Sistemas as deployment culture, Φ ≈ 1.618 as routing grammar, not a history rewrite.

If you want a map for that: From IBM SNA gateways to Omni-Lattice Chat — the repeating fractal moment. Also new on the board: When the universe slows, mass and “Now” share a gate.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
